_doc: Random events (src/game/world_events.gd). From start_day on, every new week draws one omen from `weekly` (by weight) that holds for the whole week and affects every player alike; every new day each player has fortune_chance to meet one fortune from `fortunes` (only that player). All rolls use the game RNG. A game can turn events off with the rule random_events: false (a campaign chapter's "random_events"). Weekly effects: growth_pct {pct} (this week's dwelling growth in towns and on map sites), growth_tier {tiers [min, max], pct} (one rolled tier grows by pct more), hero_boon {mods} (every hero gets HeroModifiers mods until the week ends; heroes hired that week too), income_pct {resources [], pct} (daily income of those resources this week), resources_random {pool [], amount [min, max]} (every player gets the same rolled resource and amount once), neutral_growth {pct} (every neutral army on the map grows), plague {pct} (each day of the week every hero army loses pct of each stack of living creatures, rounded down, never its last creature), roamer {packs [{name, stacks [{creature, count, per_week}]}], steps, bounty {resource: n}, ravage {gold, pool_pct}} (one pack rises in the wilds far from every town and walks steps tiles a day toward the nearest held town; at an undefended town it ravages it and leaves; beating it pays the bounty; see src/game/roaming_threats.gd), spoils_pct {pct} (extra gold per experience for beating neutral armies). Fortune effects: resources {resource, amount [min, max]}, lose_pct {resource, pct, max} (lose a share, at most max), xp {amount} (one of the player's heroes), hero_boon {mods, days} (one hero), recruit {tiers [min, max], weeks} (creatures of the player's faction join a hero with room). A fortune whose effect cannot apply (no hero, no room) is skipped.

mana_tide.name: Mana Tide
mana_tide.text: A gentle tide of magic restores two extra mana each day.

quiet_week.name: A Quiet Week
quiet_week.text: No omen darkens the sky this week.

teeming_moon.name: Teeming Moon
teeming_moon.text: A swollen moon hangs over the land. Dwellings everywhere bring forth half again as many creatures.

lean_week.name: Lean Week
lean_week.text: Blight in the granaries. Dwellings bring forth a quarter fewer creatures this week.

levy_week.name: Week of the Levy
levy_week.text: Heralds ride from hamlet to hamlet. One rank of creatures musters in double numbers.

blood_sky.name: Blood Sky
blood_sky.text: The sky burns red from dusk to dawn. Every army fights with fury: +1 attack for all heroes this week.

ashfall.name: Ashfall
ashfall.text: Grey ash falls for days and chokes the roads. All heroes move 15% slower this week.

dry_roads.name: Dry Roads
dry_roads.text: A dry wind hardens the mud. All heroes move 10% farther this week.

dread_week.name: Week of Dread
dread_week.text: Wailing on the wind at night. Soldiers lose heart: -1 morale for all heroes this week.

tithe_riots.name: Tithe Riots
tithe_riots.text: The tax collectors are driven off with pitchforks. Gold income falls by a quarter this week.

rich_veins.name: Rich Veins
rich_veins.text: Miners strike fresh seams. Every mine and yard yields half again as much this week.

starfall.name: Starfall
starfall.text: Burning stones fall from the sky. Every lord's scavengers bring home the same strange harvest.

gathering_dark.name: The Gathering Dark
gathering_dark.text: Things gather in the wild places. Every neutral army grows by a fifth.

plague_week.name: The Grey Cough
plague_week.text: A coughing sickness runs through every camp. Living soldiers die by the day; the dead and the made do not notice. Dwellings bring forth a tenth fewer creatures.

roaming_horror.name: Something Walks
roaming_horror.text: Shepherds flee the high pastures. A horror has risen in the wilds and walks toward the nearest town. Whoever brings it down will be paid in gold and gems.

hunters_moon.name: Hunters' Moon
hunters_moon.text: Every lord posts bounties on the beasts of the wild. Beating a neutral army this week pays a quarter more gold per experience.

market_fair.name: The Ember Fair
market_fair.text: Traders come from every road for the great fair. Gold income rises by a fifth this week.

long_night.name: The Long Night
long_night.text: The red sky dims to a bruise and stays that way. Every hero sees one tile less this week.

lost_caravan.name: Lost Caravan
lost_caravan.text: Your scouts find a merchant caravan abandoned on the road.

timber_raft.name: Drifting Rafts
timber_raft.text: Timber rafts torn loose upriver wash up on your shores.

ore_cart.name: Abandoned Ore Carts
ore_cart.text: A collapsed mine road leaves loaded ore carts for the taking.

store_fire.name: Fire in the Stores
store_fire.text: A fire breaks out in your treasury at night.

wandering_scholar.name: Wandering Scholar
wandering_scholar.text: A grey-bearded scholar shares the campfire and tells of old campaigns.

pilgrims_blessing.name: Pilgrims' Blessing
pilgrims_blessing.text: A band of pilgrims blesses one of your hosts as it passes.

deserters.name: Deserters Return
deserters.text: Men who fled an earlier battle come back, ashamed, and ask to serve again.
